```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: 05_process_hand_coding.R
# PURPOSE: Reconcile coder entries, evaluate inter-rater reliability,
#          merge with catalog performance metrics, and export analysis_data.csv
# ==============================================================================


library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(irr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load Completed Hand-Coding File
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
input_path <- "data/processed/hand_coding_completed.csv"

if (!file.exists(input_path)) {
  stop("Cannot find '", input_path, "'. Please ensure the completed CSV is saved there.")
}

coded_raw <- read_csv(input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
message("Loaded ", nrow(coded_raw), " rows from ", input_path)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Evaluate Inter-Rater Reliability Across Overlap Sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standardize column names to lowercase and strip unwanted spaces
names(coded_raw) <- tolower(gsub(" ", "_", names(coded_raw)))

overlap_games <- coded_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(secondary_coder) & secondary_coder != "")

message("\n=======================================================")
message("INTER-RATER RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT (N = ", nrow(overlap_games), " overlap games)")
message("=======================================================")

flags <- c("monetization_none", "cosmetic_only", "gameplay_advantage", "paywalled_content")

reliability_results <- purrr::map_dfr(flags, function(flag) {
  # Find columns that match coder 1/coder 2 and the flag name regardless of underscore placement
  c1_match <- grep(paste0("coder.*1.*", flag), names(overlap_games), value = TRUE)
  c2_match <- grep(paste0("coder.*2.*", flag), names(overlap_games), value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(c1_match) == 0 || length(c2_match) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find matching columns for category: '", flag, "'. Check names(coded_raw).")
  }
  
  r1 <- as.integer(replace_na(overlap_games[[c1_match[1]]], 0L))
  r2 <- as.integer(replace_na(overlap_games[[c2_match[1]]], 0L))
  
  stats <- calc_binary_agreement(r1, r2)
  
  tibble(
    category = flag,
    raw_agreement_pct = paste0(stats$percent_agreement, "%"),
    adjusted_score = stats$agreement_score,
    interpretation = case_when(
      stats$agreement_score >= 0.81 ~ "Near-perfect agreement",
      stats$agreement_score >= 0.61 ~ "Substantial agreement",
      stats$agreement_score >= 0.41 ~ "Moderate agreement",
      stats$agreement_score >= 0.21 ~ "Fair agreement",
      TRUE                          ~ "Slight / Poor agreement"
    )
  )
})

print(as.data.frame(reliability_results))
message("=======================================================\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Automated Discrepancy Reconciliation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rule: If coder 1 provided an entry, use it. If missing, fall back to coder 2.
clean_coding <- coded_raw |>
  mutate(
    monetization_none  = as.integer(coalesce(coder1_monetization_none, coder2_monetization_none, 0L)),
    cosmetic_only      = as.integer(coalesce(coder1_cosmetic_only, coder2_cosmetic_only, 0L)),
    gameplay_advantage = as.integer(coalesce(coder1_gameplay_advantage, coder2_gameplay_advantage, 0L)),
    paywalled_content  = as.integer(coalesce(coder1_paywalled_content, coder2_paywalled_content, 0L))
  ) |>
  select(
    appid,
    name,
    is_free,
    base_price_usd,
    primary_genre,
    cat_35_iap = cat_35_iap_screening,
    dlc_count_total,
    monetization_none,
    cosmetic_only,
    gameplay_advantage,
    paywalled_content
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Merge with Catalog Performance Metrics (Review Counts & Percentages)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check if catalog_clean exists in environment; if not, read from parquet/csv
if (!exists("catalog_clean")) {
  catalog_path <- "data/processed/steam_broad_catalog.parquet"
  if (file.exists(catalog_path)) {
    catalog_clean <- arrow::read_parquet(catalog_path)
  } else {
    stop("Cannot find catalog_clean in environment or '", catalog_path, "'.")
  }
}

analysis_data <- clean_coding |>
  inner_join(
    catalog_clean |> select(appid, positive, negative, total_reviews, positive_pct),
    by = "appid"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Key econometric continuous transformations
    log_reviews = log(total_reviews),
    # Consolidated indicator for stacking multiple monetization practices
    monetization_count = cosmetic_only + gameplay_advantage + paywalled_content
  ) |>
  distinct(appid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Export Final Clean Modeling Dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
output_path <- "data/processed/analysis_data.csv"
write_csv(analysis_data, output_path)

message("SUCCESS! Step 2 complete.")
message("Exported: ", output_path)
message("Total rows ready for regression: ", nrow(analysis_data))
message("\nMonetization Type Frequency Summary:")
print(colSums(analysis_data[, c("monetization_none", "cosmetic_only", "gameplay_advantage", "paywalled_content")]))
```
